Contact

Who you are calling

A small team in Pakistan. Ring the number and a person who knows the software answers. If you would rather see it than read about it, we will walk one class through with you on a call.

Phone

WhatsApp

Email

Set CONTACT_PHONE, CONTACT_WHATSAPP and CONTACT_EMAIL in config.js on the deployment. A page this careful with an unset phone number is worse than a plain page with a real one.

What a first call covers

  • Your own fee structure, in your own words, against what the software can hold. If it cannot hold something, you find out on the call.
  • Moving the records you already have. Bring a sample of your spreadsheet and we will tell you honestly how much of it imports cleanly.
  • One month of challans for one class, run beside your existing register, so the decision is made on your numbers rather than on a demonstration.
